chapter: The band, its players and singers
title: Lester Young and Herschel Evans as the tenor sound of the band
summary: Basie says the pairing of Lester and Herschel was one of the great combinations and that he leaned on tenors and the rhythm section to style the band.

story.theme_name: Lester Young: the man, the sound, the Basie years
story.community_name: Remembering Lester Young: Prez the man and his sound

blocks.x: All right. Let's talk about tenor men, do you mind?
No.
Cause a birdie told me you liked tenor men.
Who?
A birdie told me you liked tenor men. you'll have to tell me. Somewhere along the line you liked the tenor. And you have had the greatest tenor men.
Let me ask you this: With Lester and Hershel starting off --
What?
Would Lester and Hershel starting off --
With them starting off --
With you, being the original combination, the original great... weren't they?
Yeah.
Do you realize you look sometimes like --
With Lester and Hershel starting off, what question is that.
I want to go from there is to something else. Now, I am wondering, given the fact that they were the great combination as far as tenor goes, the great combination, unsurpassed --
I think was one of the great combinations.
Was Lester and Hershel.
Yeah, for me, it was, for me. I don't know what it would have been for anybody else.
Well, didn't just as Walter Page, was there to make the bass sound for the Basie band style, would you say that Lester and Hershel were there to make the tenor sound?
Yes.
And that was the Basie style.
(inaudible) that's right.
: So that --
That's the way I meant, I sort of styled the band in those days, just the rhythm section and tenors, I mean and I think they played hard on those guys sides --
: You what?

I think I played pretty hard on the tenors, I leaned kind of heavy on them that way, you know. I think on some of the recordings, I mean the men sort of listened to these tenor solos, along with people like Buck and Dickie Wells and stuff, you know.
Okay. You wanted full brass, but the tenor is still the key instrument.
Well, I think for me, I think they were --
: The brass filled out the sound, but the tenor gave the solo.
No.
: No.
Yeah, I think so. (inaudible)
